statement: For F ∈ Dlcc(Bη̄, E), any finite set I, and any representations V = (Vi)i∈I, there are natural isomorphisms (5.1) cI,V (F) : Hs I,V (ΨBF) ∼ − − → ΨB×SUI Hη̄ I,V (F)  . They are compatible with the tensor unit, successive Hecke modifications and their convolution maps, permutations, and ordinary pullback along every collision diagonal. The functors have the relative normalization of (2.9). Suppose, moreover, that F has a coherent eigenstructure with lisse tensor eigenvalue V 7→ Lη̄,V on Uη̄. Suppose the lisse lattices specialize to a tensor system V 7→ Ls,V on Us as in Proposition 2.1. Then ΨBF has a coherent eigenstructure with this special-fiber eigenvalue: (5.2) Hs I,V (ΨF) ≃ (ΨF) ⊠ ⊠i∈ILs,Vi . This conclusion does not assert that ΨF is nonzero; nonvanishing is supplied separately by Theorem 4.2.
